from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """A specific liability amount extracted from one company's financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The legal name of the registrant company as written in the document")
    liability_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written (e.g. 'Accounts payable', 'Accounts payable and accrued expenses')")
    amount_value: str | None = Field(description="The raw numerical amount as written in the document")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount as written (e.g. 'thousands', 'dollars')")
    reporting_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the balance was reported as written in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_records: list[FinancialRecord]
